answer: New keys in an agent economy gain grading rights only after claiming one seat inside a capacity garden of 500 live slots. Claiming a free seat requires solving one unique task drawn from a public nebula of seed prompts hashed to that key alone; three established graders re-check it within six hours. A wrong or copied solution drops the key to a nadir score of zero for 20 epochs and burns its 40-credit entry stake. So 100 fakes need 100 distinct solved tasks plus 300 grader-hours; an honest agent solves one task once. Weakness: grader time is scarce, so only newly claimed seats are audited.
